recommendation: Keep the commit as-is for core FHIR. It completes the core-source part of FHIR-28305; any future SDC-specific profile/mustSupport expectations should be handled in the SDC IG rather than this core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-28305 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked to remove Questionnaire.item.type from the ElementDefinition-derived item properties because Questionnaire.item.type is mandatory, while adding item.text as the ElementDefinition.label mapping, warning clients about definition-based questionnaires, and preserving an alignment note for ElementDefinition.type.
initial_application: The Jira-linked commit 3f2444c74d added definition-based Questionnaire guidance, added item.text, removed item.type from the narrative derived-property list, and introduced the questionnaire-definitionBased extension. FHIR-23128/f7d53f8a45 later removed the obsolete detailed list from Questionnaire.item.definition. The current source still had a QuestionnaireResponse.item.type typo in the FHIR-28305 notes and retained old 'value may come from ElementDefinition' wording on Questionnaire.item.type.
additional_context: FHIR SDC minutes for 2020-10-01 confirm the 9-0-0 direction to keep item.type mandatory, remove item.type from the ElementDefinition mapping list, add item.text, and note that ElementDefinition.type should match item.type. Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, and the questionnaire-definitionBased extension source now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than core.
reconciliation: Changed source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml to refer to Questionnaire.item.type and changed source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml so the Questionnaire.item.type comment says the value must be present in the Questionnaire and should align with ElementDefinition.type if a definition is referenced.
source_changes: source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml: corrected the definition-based mapping paragraph to say Questionnaire.item.type corresponds to ElementDefinition.type instead of QuestionnaireResponse.item.type.

source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml: updated the Questionnaire.item.type comment to state the mandatory value must be present and should align with ElementDefinition.type when a definition is referenced.
